v: Calgary's proposed four-year budget is out November tenth. Here's what preliminary City numbers say twenty twenty-seven needs.

Requests for new ongoing operating money total five hundred twenty-eight million dollars. Available funding covers one hundred forty-four million. The City pairs the other three hundred eighty-four million with a fifteen per cent tax revenue increase: council's July guidance.
The City's scenarios: holding services on their current trend takes about four to five per cent a year. Improving and expanding them, about twenty per cent in twenty twenty-seven.
On a home at the median assessment of seven hundred six thousand dollars, the City estimates fifteen per cent means about thirty-six dollars more a month in City property tax.
These numbers are preliminary, not final. Public submissions and deliberations start November twenty-third, with approval expected in late November.
